title: [DEV] Overlapping temp basals in history possibly causing wrong IOB
symptom: Basals not cancelling correctly (or not showing up in history) causing wrong IOB results. AAPS thought a temp basal was still running and the IOB counter kept increasing every 5 minutes even after a new basal started.
cause: Overlapping temp basals in history, possibly due to a bug in the pump driver. The issue was fixed by a commit.
